subject: Re: FintechX POC - Observability plan & success criteria
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-28T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: POC scope & initial observability ask

Alex — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of call:
- Goal: Evaluate Redwood for production inference for FintechX customer-facing chat (KYC/transaction questions)
- Primary concerns: latency consistency (P95), error surface (4xx/5xx), cost per 1k tokens, and auditability for compliance reviews

Proposed POC (2-week):
- Environment: Redwood Dedicated trial (sandbox project) with synthetic & small real traffic (anonymized)
- Success criteria (tentative):
  1) P95 request latency <= 450ms for 1k-token median workload
  2) End-to-end error rate < 0.5% (excluding upstream validation rejects)
  3) Traceable request -> response with user id hashed for audit
  4) Token cost visibility to within 10% of estimate

Observability plan (high level):
- Dashboards: per-route latency distribution (P50/P90/P95/P99), token usage by route/model, cost estimate dashboard
- Tracing: distributed traces for request lifecycle, sampling at 100% for errors, 10% for successful requests
- Logs: structured request/response metadata (no PII), KV cache hit/miss metrics
- Metrics to monitor: requests/s, errors/s, latency histogram, tokens/generated, model queue depth, GPU utilization

Ask: Can you confirm POC target dates (you mentioned early Nov) and ownership on your side (engineering + security reviewer)? I attached a quick checklist for observability so we can refine.

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm: POC start week and primary FintechX owners
2) Redwood and FintechX align on data handling & anonymization for traces
3) Schedule 30-min kickoff to finalize instrumentation and dashboards

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Attachment: FintechX-POC-Observability-Checklist.xlsx

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechx.com>

Date: 2026-10-29T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: POC scope & initial observability ask

Thanks Sean — that summary looks right. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Timeline: we can start the POC the week of Nov 6 and run for ~2 weeks.
- Owners: Elena Park (engineering lead) will be the technical owner; I (Alex) will own success criteria and procurement.
- Metrics: please add P50, P90, P95, and tail-latency (P99); also want request-level token counts and an aggregated cost-per-day estimate.
- Security: we'll need to validate logs & traces can't contain raw PII — hashing user ids is fine but we need retention details.

Please confirm the kickoff time; Elena is available Nov 6 after 10am PT.

Alex

alex.johnson@fintechx.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechx.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-30T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: POC scope & initial observability ask

Alex — great, thanks for confirming. Based on Sean's draft and your requests, I put together a concise POC observability plan and success criteria. See bullets below — happy to iterate. Attachment: redwood-poc-observability-template.pdf

POC observability plan (detailed):
- Dashboards (Redwood Console pre-baked):
  * POC Health Overview: total requests, success rate, error breakdown (4xx/5xx), tokens/day, estimated cost/day
  * Latency Distribution: histogram with P50/P90/P95/P99 and moving window for SLA alerting
  * Model Performance: per-model token throughput, GPU utilization, queue depth
  * Cost Drilldown: tokens by route, cache hit ratio impact, estimated USD per 1k tokens

- Tracing & Logs:
  * Tracing: propagate request id; sample 100% for errors, 10% for success; include hashed user_id, route, model_version, latency_ms, token_count
  * Logs: structured JSON lines with request_id, timestamp, status_code, error_type (if any); logs to be exported to your Splunk/Datadog/GCP Logging (you pick)
  * Retention: adjustable — default POC retention 14 days; security team wants 90-day options for audit (we can support via export)

- Metrics to monitor (we recommend):
  * requests_total (per-route)
  * errors_total (4xx/5xx)
  * latency_ms_bucket (histogram)
  * tokens_generated_total
  * cache_hit_ratio
  * gpu_utilization_percentage
  * model_queue_depth

- Success criteria (finalizable):
  1) P95 latency <= 450ms for typical route under test load
  2) Error rate < 0.5%
  3) End-to-end tracing for >=95% of error cases
  4) Cost estimate within 10% of observed tokens-based estimate

Ownership & timeline:
- FintechX: Elena Park (technical owner) — instrumentation, Splunk/Datadog access, anonymization sign-off
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (POC lead) + Sean (SSE) — instrumentation support, dashboard setup, and runbook
- Timeline: Kickoff on Nov 6 -> instrumentation & test traffic Nov 7-10 -> evaluation window Nov 11-20 -> debrief week of Nov 23

Immediate next steps:
1) Confirm kickoff slot on Nov 6 after 10am PT — propose 10:30am PT
2) Elena to share logging/ingestion point (Datadog/Splunk/GCS) and security contact for retention discussion
3) We'll provision a sandbox project and push the dashboard links pre-kickoff

Let me know if you want any items tightened up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Product Lead, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-poc-observability-template.pdf
